answer: A new identity may grade only after it posts, at dawn, a 48-hour irrevocable lock of spendable fees into a grove escrow together with a hash-committed hardware attestation. When the lock matures, a public VRF discloses a comet index into the rolling receipt window; two established notaries then open the commitment and burn the escrow if that receipt collides with any other in the window or if the same lock is reused. Operator-spawned flocks share attestations or cannot fund a distinct lock for each clone, so they never gain voting weight.
